title: maku-factory values
description: Strict for apps, runTokens and hardening; the other keys stay free until their rollout step (v4 D13, step 1 PR4).

clusterRoles.description: Render the cluster's shared ClusterRoles (the three aggregated roles, and agent-factory-flux-reader with monitor.flux). The umbrella sets false: agent-factory-crds renders them once per cluster (step 7 R10).

apps.description: The GitHub Apps (v4 D12): each key maps onto an older one, which keeps working. docs/github-apps.md.

factory.description: The factory App: issues, labels, statuses and merges. Wins over githubSecret when set.

existingSecret.description: A Secret with keys app_id and private_key.

agents.description: The agents App: each run's token and the publisher's. Wins over runTokens.appSecret; both set and different fail the render.

existingSecret.description: A Secret with keys app_id and private_key, mounted at /etc/agent-factory-agents.

mode.description: separate: the merger App in mergerSecret. factory: the merger signs with the factory App, and mergerSecret must stay unset.

publisher.description: Removed in v4 step 8. The one value it allows is the message a render shows.
enum: removed in v4 step 8: set config.hardening.publisher.minter (docs/upgrading.md#the-xr-run-kind-and-octo-sts)
